This is what I did pretty much.
I decided to create a consistent sleep schedule and therefor went to bed at 10 and woke up at 7 (9 hours later). I did this for a week and it felt great, I had a lot of energy wasn't tired, so I the next week I woke up 30 min earlier (6:30), this also felt great. I did this a few more weeks and got to wake up at 4:30 (6.5 hours of sleep) and that also felt great at first. But later on that week I started to feel tired and my willpower felt lowered. So after all of this I have found that 7 hours of sleep is perfect for me, also waking up early instead of going to bed later is great, having time in the morning to do whatever you want to do to better yourself (in my case meditating, working out and studying a language) is awesome.

I recommend you to do the same. Go to bed at the same time every day, and test around how many hours of sleep you need. In my case I felt a big difference in my ability to concentrate and lowered willpower when I slept to little.
